name: nodsynth
title: dsynth taken out of the engine list and the preset browser
status_note: content only; bench checks the SQL on synthetic and (with the firmware) the real databases; not yet on the device
summary: Content only, no TE code changed: dsynth's row leaves the engine list (synth_types) and its 16 factory presets leave the preset browser (folder dsynth). The default sound of synth slot 5 (used on first boot / after a factory reset) was the dsynth preset 'legacy'; it becomes the string preset 'piano of love', copied from the factory database at build time. dsynth's code stays, so sounds already saved with dsynth still load and play.
controls: none: dsynth is gone from the engine list and the preset browser

sql: UPDATE synth_slots SET patch = (SELECT patch FROM f.synth_presets WHERE folder = 'string' AND json_extract(patch, '$.name') = 'piano of love') WHERE json_extract(patch, '$.type') = 'dsynth'
